children: Consumer discretionary stocks are closely tied to household spending, consumer confidence and the broader economic cycle, with performance varying significantly across autos, retail, leisure and luxury goods.

Within the sector, automakers and auto-parts companies are influenced by vehicle demand and production trends, while retailers and leisure businesses remain sensitive to changes in discretionary spending and consumer behavior.

Against this backdrop, a screen of consumer discretionary stocks identifies seven companies that have maintained a Strong Buy Quant Rating for at least 60 consecutive days. The group spans automobile manufacturers, leisure facilities, broadline retail, luxury goods, homebuilding, and automotive parts and equipment, providing exposure to several distinct areas of consumer demand.

Seeking Alpha's Quant Ratings system grades stocks on their relative performance on key quantitative metrics. It hones in on stocks with the strongest combination of value, growth, profitability, EPS revisions and price momentum relative to their sector peers.
